name: comp-49
title: CVC Code Input
description: A CVC/CVV input using react-payment-inputs getCVCProps() which enforces 3-4 digit length and validation.
use_when: Payment forms as part of the card details entry flow.
avoid_when: You need custom CVC validation or want to avoid the library.
a11y: Label linked to input. Length validation is handled by the library.
